data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian language, Arastoo means 'the powerful one' or 'the majestic one'. This name evokes feelings of courage and strength. The name Arastoo carries the meaning “Majestic, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Arastoo usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
